_comment: Complete ΥΠΕΝ forest-service directory (DATA_DECISIONS 2026-08-17): every unit row of the 7 «Επιθεώρηση Εφαρμογής Δασικής Πολιτικής» contact tables on ypen.gov.gr (fetched 2026-08-16 via windowed Playwright — Akamai blocks bots; cache data/processed/ypen_offices_cache/, scripts/harvest_ypen_offices.py). REFERENCE layer only: authority_name cross-links to the 103-entry contract registry where the unit matches; entries without it award nothing in our datasets.
